title: Analysis of the User Perception of Chatbots in Education Using A Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling Approach
reasoning: The paper includes 'Transparency and Ethics (TE)' as a core construct within its structural equation model. It establishes specific hypotheses (H10, H11c) to evaluate how users' ethical perceptions of LLM chatbots affect their intention to use them in an educational context.
